answer: Every display panel leaves the factory with unique color and brightness uniformity variations. The agent measures its panel's uniformity map and submits a signed hash of it. A ripple of variation across the panel makes each map distinct. Factory calibration records strong as cedar confirm the map's plausibility. A haven of genuine panels is kept in the registry, and two identities sharing one panel map are rejected as clones. A farm of headless virtual machines has no panel at all.
